articles.headline: Randle sounds off after Bulls rout Nets: 'That was embarrassing'
articles.description: After a 30-point drubbing at the hands of the Bulls, veteran Julius Randle called the Nets' effort "embarrassing" and called out the team's pride and effort.

articles.headline: John Collins scores 20 points and Pistons hit 17 3s in 122-109 win over Pelicans
articles.description: — John Collins hit four 3-pointers and scored 20 points to lead seven Detroit players in double figures as the Pistons beat the New Orleans Pelicans 122-109 on Wednesday night.

articles.description: — Onyeka Okongwu scored 28 points, Nickeil Alexander-Walker added 19 and the Atlanta Hawks outlasted the Oklahoma City Thunder 117-112 on Wednesday night.

articles.headline: Cooper Flagg scores 33 as Mavericks keep Warriors winless since Stephen Curry's injury
articles.description: — Cooper Flagg scored 33 points, P.J. Washington Jr. added 21 and the Dallas Mavericks stopped a three-game losing streak with a 116-94 victory over the Golden State Warriors on Wednesday night.

articles.headline: Davis and Dybantsa lead the Wizards past the Raptors 103-99 in a matchup of struggling teams
articles.description: — Anthony Davis had 25 points and 14 rebounds, rookie AJ Dybantsa added 23 points and 12 boards, and the Washington Wizards beat the undermanned Toronto Raptors 103-99 on Wednesday night to snap an eight-game losing streak.
